title: Planning what to make
summary: See which open orders need stock made and start production runs for what is short.

steps.text: Open {dp} from the sidebar to see every open order that needs something made.
The board breaks demand down by document type, including {po}; tick the lines you are ready to build and choose Make from the bulk actions above the table.
To track the demand as its own order instead of a run, open {so} from the sidebar.
